note: The first enables content.code.annotate, the second explains how to place annotations in a code block.

question: sticky navigation tabs
note: Feature flag that keeps the navigation tabs visible below the header while scrolling.

note: Gives the mermaid code block syntax for a sequence diagram.

question: announcement bar
note: Explains overriding the announce block to show a bar above the header.

note: Shows the ++ctrl+alt+del++ syntax of the Keys extension.

question: image zoom lightbox
note: Recommends and configures the glightbox plugin for image zoom.

question: sortable tables
note: Integrates tablesort via additional JavaScript to sort data tables.

question: How can I add a small button to each code block so readers can copy the code to their clipboard?
note: Enables content.code.copy, which renders a copy-to-clipboard button on code blocks.

question: I would like my readers to be able to switch between different versions of the documentation, like 1.x and 2.x, with some kind of dropdown in the header. Is that possible and what do I need to configure?
note: Sets extra.version.provider to mike, which renders a version selector in the header.

question: What is the easiest way to have my documentation built and deployed to GitHub Pages automatically every time I push a commit to the main branch?
note: Provides a ready GitHub Actions workflow that deploys on push.

question: Is there some way to show at the bottom of each page the date when that page was last changed, ideally taken from the git history?
note: Sets up the git-revision-date-localized plugin for last update and creation dates.

question: We want to collect some quick feedback from readers, so could I put a little thumbs up or thumbs down question asking whether the page was helpful at the end of every page?
note: Configures the feedback widget shown at the bottom of each page.

question: When a reader picks a tab like Python in one set of content tabs, can all the other tab groups on the site switch to Python as well, so they don't have to click every single one?
note: content.tabs.link links all content tabs so they switch to the same label.

question: Wie füge ich eine Suchleiste hinzu?
note: The built-in search plugin adds client-side search and is re-added in mkdocs.yml.

question: Wie kann ich mathematische Formeln mit LaTeX darstellen?
note: Both sections configure a library that renders LaTeX formulas; either answers equally well.

question: Wie richte ich einen Cookie-Banner ein, der vor dem Laden von Google Analytics um Zustimmung fragt?
note: Configures the native cookie consent form shown before third-party requests.

note: Enables rendering footnotes as inline tooltips.

question: navigaton breadcrums above title
note: navigation.path renders a breadcrumb navigation above the page title.
